Jumped Ok trapped Wide early then worked to settle outside leader. under pressure turn. dropped right out. worked early but # very poor
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: When questioned regarding the performance of the filly, rider advised that her mount did not travel at any stage of the event, failed to respond to her riding in the straight and was disappointing. A post-race veterinary examination of the filly did not reveal any abnormality.
